# GSAP runtime

GSAP 3.14.2 and ScrollTrigger 3.14.2, vendored locally so the static homepage works offline.

Sources:
- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gsap@3.14.2/dist/gsap.min.js
- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gsap@3.14.2/dist/ScrollTrigger.min.js

The original distribution license headers are preserved. Official documentation and license: https://gsap.com/docs/v3/Installation/ and https://gsap.com/standard-license/.
